environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as root user inside a Docker container with --privileged flag. Container image includes standard coreutils, curl, wget, netcat. The container runs with default seccomp profile disabled (--security-opt seccomp=unconfined). Network: instance is in a public subnet with full outbound internet access via IGW. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. ADMIN_SECRET is set to a 32-char hex string known to authorized admins. No additional process-level sandboxing or syscall filtering is applied. The Flask app runs directly via python app.py with no reverse proxy.

config.network: public subnet, full egress, SG inbound 8080/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0
